summary.text: Bryan Cohn is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 32 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as agriculture.

paragraphs.text: Bryan Cohn won the District 32 seat in the November 5, 2024, general election, defeating incumbent Republican Frank Sossamon and Libertarian Ryan Brown, and assumed office on January 1, 2025.
His 2026 general election opponent is Sossamon.
